description: Use when the marketer says: make me a video ad, a 30-second ad for paid social, a Reel / TikTok / Shorts ad, a UGC-style video made with AI (no real creator), a product demo video, remake this ad I like for my brand, cut our best organic video into an ad, more like my winning video with new hooks, my video ad got rejected — fix it. Delivers a produced, ready-to-post video ad grounded in a researched angle: one message, a hook for the first two seconds, every claim traced to the brand's signed-off claims, no generated person posing as a customer, the exact words and the price approved before anything renders (one video, or one plus two hook variants), an honest review of the result, priced fixes only on a yes, and launch copy and notes for the ads team. Works in chat apps. Never publishes or spends ad budget. Not for real creators filming for you — work-with-creators (unsure? ask: AI-made or a real person); not for a phone-shot organic post — run-organic-social; not for static ads — make-static-ads.
